subject: POC trial environment setup — hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@finco.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finco.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial environment setup — hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC

Hi Asha / Tom —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Call takeaways / success criteria (what you told us):
- Integration latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 300ms for typical customer queries (seq len ~512).
- Cost target: reduce per-1k-token cost vs current vendor by >= 30%.
- Data controls: logs must not leave FinCo; KMS-backed key management required for any private deployment.
- Stability: 7-day trial with sustained throughput of ~5 rps baseline, burst to 20 rps.

Recommended evaluation plan / environments to consider:
1) Hosted Redwood trial (fastest setup) — Redwood-managed, shared hosted cluster, good for latency/cost baseline.
2) Dedicated sandbox — reserved GPU pool for FinCo for consistent throughput and isolation; requires a short capacity reservation.
3) VPC trial (Private) — we provision a private control plane with VPC peering and KMS integration; best for security/compliance validation but longer setup (network + firewall).

Proposed POC timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): Agree on success criteria + pick environment option.
- Week 1: If Hosted — creds & runbook shared; if Dedicated/VPC — infra checklist + network kickoff.
- Week 2-3: Run tests, collect perf & cost metrics, iterate on prompt/quantization profile.
- Week 4: Review results, finalize next steps for production rollout.

Ownership / next steps (action items):
- Marissa (me): coordinate trial setup, schedule kickoff, share runbook and baseline prompts.
- Neha (SE): technical onboarding, obs dashboards, and evaluation scripts.
- Rishi (AE): finalize commercial terms for dedicated sandbox if you pick that route.
- Asha / Tom: confirm which environment you want to start with and provide an admin contact + basic network info (for VPC).

Attachments: poc-runbook.pdf (setup steps + baseline prompts), scope.xlsx (evaluation scope).

Can you confirm target environment and an admin contact by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Marissa – thanks for the clear recap. Couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria look right; add one item for output consistency: token-level top-k stability across runs for our top-10 prompts.
- For initial run we'd prefer Hosted to move fastest, but we will need to validate VPC/KMS during the trial window as a hard blocker for procurement.

Can you send the Hosted credentials and runbook so our infra person can start smoke tests? If Hosted perf is promising, we may request a one-week Dedicated sandbox to validate sustained throughput.

Admin contact: Tom Reynolds (tom.reynolds@finco.com) — he will own network conversations if we progress to VPC.

Thanks,
Asha
Director, AI Platform | FinCo

Thanks Asha — good note on output consistency. Updated plan below and a proposed quick decision matrix to help choose environment: 

Decision matrix (quick):
- If you want fastest time to signal + benchmarking across several prompts: Hosted.
- If you need isolation and deterministic throughput for load tests: Dedicated sandbox (we can reserve 1-2 GPUs for the week).
- If procurement requires on-prem/VPC + KMS: Private (VPC). Longer lead-time (2-3 weeks) for networking & security review.

Proposed immediate steps to start Hosted trial (if you confirm):
- I will provision a short-lived API key for your infra team and share the poc-runbook.pdf.
- Neha will provide a minimal eval script (k6 + our perf harness) and Grafana access to the trial dashboards.
- We'll run baseline tests within 48 hours of provisioning.

If you prefer Dedicated sandbox instead, Rishi — can you share a short pricing note and reservation process? I’ll align on timing.

HubSpot link to deal and notes: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FIN-4521

Marissa
